'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Islamic terrorism in Europe]]
**A knifeman attacks a policeman in [[Cannes]], [[France]], shouting that it was "in the name of the Prophet". The officer is not seriously wounded; the perpetrator is shot by other officers and is in critical condition. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/1963701 (Reuters via ''Arab News'')]
*[[2021 Democratic Republic of the Congo attacks]]
**Gunmen in the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] seize the villages of Tshanzu and Runyoni in [[North Kivu]], near the borders with [[Uganda]] and [[Rwanda]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/armed-men-seize-congo-villages-near-uganda-rwanda-border-2021-11-08/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Ukraine]]'s oldest [[English language]] newspaper the ''[[Kyiv Post]]'' suspends publication after 26 years in print following a dispute between its owner and journalists. All of the newspaper's journalists have been fired with immediate effect. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/nov/08/ukrainian-english-language-newspaper-kyiv-post-suspends-publication (''The Guardian'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Maradi school fire]]
**Twenty-six children are killed and 13 others injured by a fire at a school in [[Maradi, Niger|Maradi]], [[Niger]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/11/9/at-least-26-children-die-in-niger-school-fire (Al Jazeera)]
*Three [[France|French]] [[mountaineering|climbers]] who went missing two weeks ago after attempting to reach Mingbo Eiger, near [[Mount Everest]], are found dead by [[Nepal]]i police. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/3-bodies-found-near-spot-where-french-climbers-went-missing-in-nepals-himalayas-2602833 (NDTV)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Austria]]
****[[Austria]] restricts access to restaurants, bars, hotels and social and cultural events to only those who have been [[COVID-19 vaccination in Austria|vaccinated]] or who have recovered from [[COVID-19]] due to an increase in the number of new cases and hospitalizations. [https://www.euractiv.com/section/politics/short_news/austria-introduces-tough-restrictions-for-unvaccinated/ (EURACTIV)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Belgium]], [[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on education]]
****[[Belgium]] reinstates [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic|mandatory face mask]] policy for secondary schoolchildren and their teachers in [[Wallonia]]. [https://www.levif.be/actualite/belgique/port-du-masque-du-changement-dans-les-ecoles-secondaires/article-normal-1488447.html?cookie_check=1636427062 (''Le Vif'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]], [[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on education]]
****[[France]] reinstates a [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic|mandatory face mask]] policy for primary schoolchildren in many [[Departments of France|department]]s and administrative areas across the country as authorities try to reduce the number of COVID-19 cases. [https://timesofmalta.com/articles/view/french-schoolchildren-mask-up-again-as-covid-cases-rise.913566 (''Times of Malta'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]]
****[[Greece]] reports a record 7,335 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 792,239. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/europe/greece-reports-record-high-daily-covid-infections/2415477 (Anadolu Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] lifts its nationwide week-long paid holiday in most regions, which aimed to reduce the spread of COVID-19, despite still reporting high numbers of new cases and deaths. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/europe/russia-shutdown-ends-despite-coronavirus-wave/articleshow/87583206.cms (''The Times of India'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Slovakia]]
****[[Slovakia]] closes hotels, bars, fitness centers, and restaurants, as well as limiting gatherings to 100 fully [[COVID-19 vaccination in Slovakia|vaccinated]] people in 36 [[Counties of Slovakia|counties]] amid a record increase in the number of COVID-19 cases. [https://apnews.com/article/coronavirus-pandemic-europe-health-pandemics-slovakia-a53892de62b5e66d5410e4292fff0f3c (AP)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Australia]]
****[[Australia]] begins administering [[booster dose]]s of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]] for people over the age of 18 years old who received their second dose at least six months ago. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-11-08/australia-covid-booster-vaccination-program-begins-today/100601820 (ABC News Australia)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Vanuatu]]
****[[Vanuatu]]an prime minister [[Bob Loughman]] confirms that two Vanuatuan citizens who were repatriated from [[New Caledonia]] have the [[Delta variant]] and urges residents to get vaccinated. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/455211/vanuatu-confirms-covid-cases-have-delta-variant (RNZ)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]], [[Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
****[[Singapore]] and [[Malaysia]] announce that they will establish a Vaccinated Travel Lane beginning on November 29 between Singapore's [[Changi Airport]] and the [[Kuala Lumpur International Airport]] in Malaysia for fully vaccinated international travellers. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/singapore/malaysia-singapore-vtl-vaccinated-travel-lane-covid19-2298486 (CNA)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in California]]
****[[Los Angeles]] begins to implement the U.S. strictest vaccine mandate that required people to show their proof of [[COVID-19 vaccination in the United States|full vaccination]] or negative [[COVID-19 test]] results in the previous 72 hours in order to enter most indoor venues and large outdoor events of more than 5,000 attendes. [https://www.npr.org/2021/11/08/1053435012/strict-mandate-takes-effect-in-la-business-patrons-must-show-proof-of-vaccinatio (NPR)]
***[[Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
****The [[United States]] reopens its land and air borders for fully [[vaccinate]]d international travelers for non-essential purposes after a 20-month closure for 33 countries due to the pandemic. Vaccinated international travelers are required to present negative COVID-19 test results before they travel, and airlines are required to use a contact tracing system. [https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20211107-us-finally-reopens-land-and-air-borders-after-20-months (AFP via France 24)]
*[[2020–2021 H5N8 outbreak]]
**[[Poland]] reports outbreaks of the [[Influenza A virus subtype H5N8|H5N8]] [[Avian influenza|bird flu]] at one chicken and five turkey farms, with four of the outbreaks occurring in the eastern part of the country. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/poland-reports-highly-pathogenic-h5n1-bird-flu-poultry-oie-2021-11-08/ (Reuters)]
**An outbreak of the H5 bird flu is reported at a small [[poultry]] unit near [[Alcester]], [[Warwickshire]], [[England]]. The infected birds will be [[Culling|culled]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-coventry-warwickshire-59208230 (BBC News)]
*The [[World Health Organization|WHO]] and [[UNICEF]] launch a four-day [[polio]] [[polio vaccine|vaccination]] campaign in [[Afghanistan]] backed by the [[Taliban]], which aims to address the 3.3 million children who have not been vaccinated against polio since 2018. [https://www.aljazeera.com/amp/news/2021/11/8/polio-vaccination-programme-resumes-in-afghanistan (Al Jazeera)]

'''International relations'''
*[[European migrant crisis]]
**[[2021 Belarus–European Union border crisis]]
***A large crowd of migrants escorted by the [[Armed Forces of Belarus|Belarusian military]] attempts to break through the [[Belarus–Poland border]] near [[Bruzgi]], [[Grodno Region]]. Several migrants are reported dead, with seven being found dead on the Polish side of the border, and a few more deaths are reported in Belarus. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/nov/08/belarus-escorts-hundreds-of-migrants-towards-polish-border (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.itv.com/news/2021-11-08/poland-tightens-security-as-migrants-congregate-on-border-with-belarus (ITV)]
**Police in [[Star Dojran]], [[North Macedonia]] discover 42 migrants hiding in a truck. Authorities say that most of the migrants were of [[Syrians|Syrian]] descent and were likely travelling through [[Greece]]. [https://www.ekathimerini.com/news/1171345/north-macedonia-police-find-42-migrants-packed-in-a-truck/ (''Ekathimerini'')]
*[[Foreign relations of Colombia]]
**During a high-level state visit to [[Israel]], [[Ministry of National Defense (Colombia)|Colombian Defense Minister]] [[Diego Molano]] declares [[Iran]] to be an enemy of [[Colombia]] despite both nations continuing to maintain diplomatic relations. [https://www.infobae.com/america/colombia/2021/11/08/ministro-de-defensa-de-colombia-asegura-que-iran-y-hezbola-son-enemigos-de-su-pais-apoyados-por-el-regimen-de-venezuela/ (Infobae)]
*[[Holy See–Switzerland relations]]
**Swiss Foreign Minister [[Ignazio Cassis]] meets with the State Secretary of the [[Vatican City|Vatican]], Cardinal [[Pietro Parolin]], to mark 100 years of the restoration of diplomatic relations between [[Switzerland]] and the [[Holy See]]. The joint declaration, according to the [[Swiss Broadcasting Corporation]], called for the promotion of “peace and human rights, the worldwide abolition of the death penalty, the protection of minorities, and interreligious dialogue.” [https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/switzerland-marks-centenary-of-diplomatic-relations-with-holy-see/47093520 (Swissinfo)] [https://www.catholicculture.org/news/headlines/index.cfm?storyid=52842 (Catholic World News)]


'''Politics and elections'''
*Former [[President of Georgia]] [[Mikheil Saakashvili]], who has been on a [[hunger strike]] for 39 days, is moved to a [[Prison healthcare|prison hospital]] as his condition continues to deteriorate. [https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20211108-georgia-s-ex-president-saakashvili-moved-to-prison-hospital-amid-hunger-strike (France 24)]
